description: This PHP source file defines the Returns model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing customer product returns including creation, updates, deletions, and retrieval of return data and histories in the database.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for managing product return records and histories within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database using provided data.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return ID with new data.

methods.name: editReturnStatusId
methods.description: Updates the return status ID for a specific return record.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record and its histories from the database.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return record.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records based on provided filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the count of return records based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Counts return records matching a specific return status ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Counts return records matching a specific return reason ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Counts return records matching a specific return action ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Creates a new history entry for a return, updating its status and optionally notifying the customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a specific return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of history records for a specific return.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history records for a specific return.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Counts total history records for return statuses.
